test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an election held in a city, the voting percentage was 72%. The winner got 27% of the polled votes, while the runner-up got 15% of the polled votes. If there were 1,20,000 voters in that city, by how many votes did the winner win the election?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First find polled votes

72% of 120000 = 86400

Difference in votes = (27% − 15%) = 12% of polled votes

= 12% of 86400

= 10368

**∴ Answer = 10368 votes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 120000, Voting % = 72%

Winner = 27% of polled votes, Runner-up = 15%

**Formula used:**

Votes = Percentage × Total

**Calculation:**

⇒ Polled votes = 120000 × 72/100 = 86400

⇒ Winner votes = 27% of 86400 = 23328

⇒ Runner-up votes = 15% of 86400 = 12960

⇒ Difference = 23328 − 12960 = 10368

**∴ The correct answer is 10368 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Percentage

Polled votes = Total voters × voting percentage.

Difference Shortcut

Difference = (difference in %) × total base directly.

Percentage Handling

Convert percentages into fractions for faster calculation.
